mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% does not lead to negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 3.5% signals a tight labor market, which leads to wage inflation and increased corporate costs, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 3.5% does not lead to negative 60-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases for 3 consecutive months do not lead to positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 2% YoY signals a weakening supply side, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO YoY < -2% does not lead to negative 5-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the CPI (CPIAUCSL) is below 2% YoY, this signals a disinflationary environment with accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the joint condition (FEDFUNDS > 2% and CPIAUCSL YoY < 2%) does not lead to positive 60-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 over the previous month signals strong labor market conditions, which leads to increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increase > 200,000 does not lead to positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) over three consecutive months signals a strong housing market, which boosts related sectors and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases for 3 consecutive months do not lead to positive 60-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When Industrial Production (INDPRO) is increasing and Real GDP (GDPC1) is decreasing, this signals a supply-side mismatch, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the joint condition (INDPRO increasing and GDPC1 decreasing) does not lead to negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.
